This is such a cool game, especially if you've played 2018. SO MUCH was added to make it an even more realistic experience. You can now refill fluids like power steering, brakes, coolant, windshield wiper. There's a drain which allows you to drain old fluids before refilling these reservoirs.
Cars now have an ECU and a fuse box where you can check each individual fuse and relay for errors. Bolts can get stuck, so you can right click them to spray some WD-40 W-04 to loosen them. The graphics are so much better, workplace is bigger, there's an outdoors area where you can add new facilities like a carwash and more stuff I haven't unlocked yet.. I LOVE IT ♥ Also love the fact they added an electric car DLC. I'm still a petrol head but I'm interested in the way they work all the same. 999/10 game in my opinion.

Few considerations:
1. If you're looking to increase your car mechanics knowledge this game is for you. Play a good amount of hours, then inspect a car in real life and you're going to easily recognize its components.
2. This game is great to waste hours and relax. There are different ways you can play this game. Personally i like to grab cars from junkyard and make them new and shiny.
3. If you grab the Drag Racing DLC you're going to have fun tuning your cars so that they can perform against other cars in drag race.
4. The only thing that's missing from this game in my opinion is a city environment where you can drive your car and enjoy it as if it was really yours, this makes it almost pointless to own cars in the game. Would be amazing to get in your car, get on the road and drive until the city or whatever (there is some material on the workshop though). That would make great multiplayer content aswell. Nontheless you can use your cars to do laps in the race track, go in the speed track, test track or drag racing (DLC) which can be fun.

Overall if you like to mount and unmount stuff, repair things (or create) to make them shiny new or in good condition, and you want to expand your cars knowledge I highly recommend this game to you.

I really didnt think that a game as repetitive as this could be so addictive.
Cant stop bringing in car after car to earn more cash to work on the 20+ project cars I have waiting for me in my car lot. Also great community mods that just make it extra special.
This game is so addictive in a good way of course.... i wish the developers will release some new DLC with other brands like they did in the 2018 version....

Love this game! Such a great game to relax and have fun with! Easy to play regardless if you know anything about cars. It helps you learn about being a mechanic with out the frustration of banging up your hands or dropping an important screw. Definitely recommend! Very well optimized!

Fun game. Once you get past the learning curve of all the items and how to determine what you need to do for the car it is a very fun game. I have played on Xbox before and did not like the controls for the console version of the game however on my mac i have enjoyed the game very much.
good game. any car fanatic will love this. remember: the pie menu is your friend, explore it as the options change depending on what you are pointing at when you open it.

The game is fun, its not 1:1 simulator, but you get the very basic idea of how the cars work. You can own cars and there are many of them! You can even tune them :o It gets kinda repetitive after few hours, but well, thats part of the job. You can roleplay as Pay 'n' Spray, or Ralph from Mafia 1 Owo

Wasn't sure if I'd like it but it's surprisingly addictive!
And educational as well - I feel like I'm fully qualified to pull a car apart completely now! (putting it back together might be another story...)

This game has no business being this fun. Responsibilities? What are those? 4 days. 4 DAYS of doing nothing that I should be doing because I can't make myself not reopen the game on my PC first thing in the morning, and on my Steam Deck while waiting in the car. I'm getting eye strain headaches every day, but does that stop me? Of course not. I just finally reached a point of closing the game willingly after 51.4 hours; well worth full price, let alone the price I paid on sale (I got the main game and several of the expansions.). I probably should have expected this after Thief Simulator so captured my attention, but I never learn.

If you're at all interested in mechanics or understanding how engines work, you'll probably enjoy this game. It's not completely realistic, there are a lot more parts on real cars (and in real life there's this thing called transmission fluid that would need to be drained when opening the gearboxes), but if you only have a general idea of how engines are built, you will learn more about how complex they are and maybe understand more about the engineering behind them.

I'd love to be able to actually drive from place to place with a simple map, or even just be able to drive my cars around the garage; something to consider for possible future games...I hope. *hint, hint*

Very fun if you don't know jack about cars. I've learned more about leaf springs and random rubber parts than I will ever need to know. There's also a junkyard where you can buy a junk car and rebuild it, which is my favorite thing to do. Other than that, very user friendly and i will be spending at least 10,000 on this game.
I was trained to be a mechanic so I dropped in and stayed on for 10hrs the first night playing it. Simple and fun.

Very good game for people who are interested in car mechanics, but if you are looking for a good driving game this is not it driving mechanics are worse than on roblox and the game hasnt heard of downforce atall.
(download items from workshop for better experience)

Amazing game to play. It never gets boring. The game also learned me a lot more about cars. I would really recommend it for people who are searching for a fun and easy game to play. You will learn the basics of a car so fast.
Lovely game for mechanics like me! It is very realistic, however I would like to see more detail in repair. I would strongly recommend to a friend!

If you enjoy building cars, this game is really fun to play. It takes a bit to do enough jobs before you can start buying and restoring junkyard cars but it is a blast. It's fairly accurate to what you'd be doing in real life to restore a car minus some of the nuances.
First review by me. It's a nice game, i've learned a lot about cars from it. I only have the bmw dlc.

I enjoy everything in this game except driving the cars I build. Well, this is not a car racing game like Forza Horizon so this flaw is never a big deal for me.

I wish the new Drag Racing DLC could change everything.

In fact, after playing so many hours, I still have a lot of fun to build every car in this game. Now, driving the car in this game become something I would never care about anymore.
Have been enjoying the game so far! A must buy if you are into working and fixing cars
This game is absolutely amazing, there are tons of cool vehicles to fix up and customize. The new fluids and other mechanics add even more things to do so you don't get bored with it.

This Developer consistently reuses their assets to create "new" games. All of these games have the same mechanics in one way or another and are throw together with chewing gum and pop-sickle sticks. This was a barely rebranded Car mechanic sim 2018. If you loved 2018 just stick with that because this adds nothing that will make the experience better.

Avoid this dev and their sister companies if you prefer games with a good content to value ratio
It's a great game in terms of fun and education i just think it needs more realism and fine details and more unique cars and parts(a car with rear wheel steering?)

Its not bad. Some things are automated that should not be in game. There is no great detail to systems. No gaskets, no seals, no wire harnesses, no hoses, no grease, no vacuum system, no sensors, no drive axle gears.........Its pretty much engine and main parts throughout. They implemented customer vehicle fluids and tuning....but poorly. The tuning is so tedious that you will just end up avoiding the "other tasks"(Same one fluid is in) on orders. There are elements like part yards and barns where you may or may not find a car you want to work on but other then the cars........you have no worldy idea why you would look thorugh piles of 100s of parts. They missed huge opportunities to incorporate immersive simulation aspects into the game and instead filled those parts with elementary mini games and automation. These are off-putting, immersion breaking and have no place in game. Some how, in 2022, they still have not figured out how to make the work areas open and seamless.......so we get phasing through doors and station porting. This is a buy on sale but don't expect a full simulation experience.
best game i had played so far mods are free from the workshop and they work so well i wish the dlc's had a mitsubishi eclips or smth like that but other then thaat its awesome
Amazing game, would be good if they added a few more story missions but worth the money, DLCs are also very good.

Dodge DLC makes this game acceptable. Why they don't license real vehicles in the base game is completely beyond me, however.

Great game to come back to when you got an hour or two from time to time to buy cars from the scrapyard and repair them with maximum tuning to sell for a small fortune and keeping the best ones for yourself. I learned quite a bit about how engines/cars work playing this. Still looks good and supports 32:9. 
It's a great game but if I could change some things these would be some of them:
- When you finish the "story" contracts there are no more. Junkyard, barns and auctions left only (and buying new from the dealer, but I don't care about that). 
- Gearbox tuning can increase top speed but won't affect tuning rating or value.
- Tons of interesting real cars by real brands but available only as rather expensive DLCs.
- You have 5 spots to place cars at your shop. You can also move freshly bought cars from the scrapyard to your parking lots. But you can't do that anymore when you already have 5 cars at your shop. I couldn't buy my favorite car at the scrapyard because of this. 
- Aligning misaligned wheels and headlights has no impact on the value, performance or state of the car. 

I like it better than 2015 and 2018. Waiting for the successor, hoping it includes co-op and more tools.

Very authentic. Not sure how much a real mechanic gets to play around with cars at autoservice places. However, this you can eventually learn to completely repair cars from junkyard from scratch. Take apart engines and assemble them again. Or just simple liquid service. You get to see all kinds of engines and different designs of cars.

The only flaw is you really make little money, and your not warned by this, you have to start over. if you buy extra parts, invest too much in garage stuff or whatever you get stuck on orders with no remedy at this point beside grinding little profit orders. Recommend easy mode for more money, even then its not enough cos junkyard stuff will cost a lot to repair. Money side feels a little unrealistic shouldn't the shop earn way more? its like a fifteen percent profit on what was paid which is nonsense. It should be double at least if it was reality. Money aside its very practical experience.

If your considering an apprenticeship in automative, but unsure since its a four years sign up, it can show you whether you'll like it or not.

Highly recommend this game, I've played the version on console and now on here. Theres DLC I'd like on console and there's a few cars and mods/DLC I'd like on console. But I don't wanna waste money buying it. But I Highly Recommend this..

i have the 2015 on discount, 2018 on discount, when i see 2021 is selling, i buy it at full price. the hype is not a farce. this game is great!

but i get bored after having all the skills and fixed all the cars. then i left it in the game library until my fingers itching again. this game just never failed to get me hook, no matter how long i did not play or how many times i restart the game. i tried other similar games as well, nothing hits like this one.

Its great,i see many people complain about this and that,but have they tried making 2 very detailed games? or course they haven't! it does take a while to full restore a car,but once its done,you'll feel great! Although it does suck when you missed a part,the car won't start,and it has nothing to do with the car starting,but yeah,is awesome.

It's just like CMS 2018, but the added minigames for the Tire's and the scrapping/repairing makes it a little less boring. Wich is fantastic in my opinion. I recommend this game to anybody who loves cars (and fixing them) and is looking for a good game to kill some time with.
Great game too start learning about cars and how too fix em. it doesnt teach every thing, but you can understand the basics kinda well

Even expert mode is baby mode. It's just lego with cars, you slap on bolts and call it a day, no head gaskets, no tubing for hoses or wires, no thermostats, no adding paste or lubes in between crankshafts, all that stuff that is real problem in real cars, and it even tells you where missing part is in expert mode. even my little 7 year old brother manages expert mode like its nothing. Don't get me wrong but it's a fun game but you won't learn shit except part names and I wouldn't consider it a mechanic simulator. Espeicially where "fixing a part" is playing some weird minigame with a + or - u got hit in time when instead could of made it where you get sanding paper and sand rust away or open the part up to fix up fuses or whatever. Oh and theres no bushings and mounts for the engines so it usually floats. **DO NOT BUY IF YOU WANT TO LEARN FROM IT TO ACTUALLY FIX CARS IRL**

This game is for somebody who is familiar with car repair, not somebody who's interested into playing this game.

The tutorial should get into more details as how to run a car repair shop, not just how to change the oil or how to balance the tire. Tutorial just covers the straightforwardness of things, but many details, such as how to move the car to the lifter, how to buy parts off from the computer, how to buy more tools and what tools to get when you are starting...etc are left out.

Overall, I finished the tutorial and still not able to progress from the very first car. Had to google. This is bad design that is hostile to new players.
its fun but frustrating that i gotta take apart the whole car just for the last missing part to be a random bushing thats tucked away inside

This game isn't the most actuate car mechanic game but it is probably the closest you can get currently. I have a lot of time in this game and i truly think this game is the one of my favorites. i recomend getting some of the dlc if you want a more acurate experience.
Fun to play with no DLC amd even better with. Great selection of mods available too
Very good game and an easy distraction. Can easily use this game to pass the time

Great game. Really noticed a lot of improvements from 2018. Feels like devs have been listening.

love it if u like working on cars. this games for u. i have all the games. great work

Decent changes from the previous installment in this series, that provides for a wonderfully immersive gameplay loop. I only wish it were more involved, as after a few hundred hours it becomes very easy and repetitive, it is a realistic game, but I almost wish it were even more realistic. Looking forward to the next game Red Dot develops in this series to see how much further they push it.

tldr.text: Overwhelmingly Positive (96%): players praise the mods and customization, which many say make the game more fun.
The most common complaint is the price, though some players also report crashes.

details.text: Players under 2 hours in are far less positive (61%) than longer-time players, who are around 97%.
Bugs and crashes come up less often than price complaints, but one reviewer says they "lost hours of gameplay" because of crashes.
